messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Spanish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Spanish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Alignment Table (Spanish translation → Source)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (locked meaning) | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | ove | “where” – locative subordinator introducing the place of the event | donde | “where” | OK | | udirai | future action “you will hear” | oirás | “you will hear” | OK | | le | definite article marking the plural noun *strida* (feminine) | los | “the” (masc. pl., required by *gritos*) | OK | | disperate | adjective “despairing, desperate” qualifying *strida* | desesperados | “despairing” | OK | | strida | plural noun “shriek, scream” (object of *udirai*) | gritos | “shouts/screams” | OK | | vedrai | future action “you will see” | verás | “you will see” | OK | | li | definite article (masc. pl.) for *spiriti* | los | “the” (masc. pl.) | OK | | antichi | adjective “ancient, old‑time” qualifying *spiriti* | antiguos | “ancient” | OK | | spiriti | plural noun “spirits” (object of *vedrai*) | espíritus | “spirits” | OK | | dolenti | adjective “woeful, sorrowful” describing *spiriti* | afligidos | “afflicted/woeful” | OK | | ch’ (che) | relative pronoun “who/that” referring to *spiriti* | que | “who/that” | OK | | a | preposition “to/toward” marking direction of the shout | a | “to/toward” | OK | | la | definite article for the feminine noun *morte* | la | “the” | OK | | seconda | ordinal adjective “second” modifying *morte* | segunda | “second” | OK | | morte | noun “death” (object of preposition *a*) | muerte | “death” | OK | | ciascun | distributive quantifier “each” (masc. sg.) | cada | “each” | OK | | grida | verb “shouts, cries out” (present indicative) | grita | “shouts/cries out” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **None.** All source tokens are represented, correctly translated, and grammatically concordant in the Spanish rendering. No missing, wrong, grammar‑related, or unnecessary elements were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Spanish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Spanish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
